verdict.rationale: Zep documents user-level deletion (single API call deletes all threads/artifacts) explicitly framed for Right-to-be-Forgotten/privacy compliance, plus granular edge/node deletion for finer-grained control, and a CLI (zepctl) for administering data operations. Missing for 10: no documented data-retention TTL/auto-expiry policy or independent third-party verification that deletion is complete/irreversible.
